note: أصاب also commonly means 'was right; got it right; hit the target', in addition to hit/affected/injured; that success/correctness reading is important for learners.
proposed_english: hit; affected; injured; was right; got it right; hit the target

note: فصل is a major homograph: فَصْل 'class; chapter; season; section/separation' and فَصَلَ 'separated/divided/dismissed'. The current verb-only entry omits core beginner noun meanings.
proposed_english: class; chapter; season; section; separation; separated; divided; dismissed (depending on vocalization/use)

note: أسوأ is an elative comparative/superlative adjective meaning 'worse/worst', not a noun.
ساعد is also the common noun ساعِد 'forearm', in addition to the perfect verb 'helped/assisted'.
